item.title: Mahmood accused of making refugees wait up to 30 years to settle
item.body: Shabana Mahmood has been accused of causing “distress and uncertainty” to hundreds of thousands of refugees by quietly introducing a 30-year “earned settlement” plan. They had been told they could apply for indefinite leave after five years.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🏠 Mahmood accused of making refugees wait up to 30 years to settle

Shabana Mahmood has been accused of causing “distress and uncertainty” to hundreds of thousands of refugees by quietly introducing a 30-year “earned settlement” plan. They had been told they could apply for indefinite leave after five years.

Source: Guardian | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 5 November, 14:50

#BreakingNews #Asylum #Immigration
